title: ManifestCommit
description: One immutable JSON commit in the per-run capsule manifest chain (cap-001, FR-01).

version.description: Monotonically increasing per (tenant, run_id) pair; starts at 1.

operation.description: 'put' for new capsule; 'tombstone' for logical deletion after retention expiry.

capsule_sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of canonical capsule bytes.

novaseal_leaf_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the NovaSeal Merkle-log leaf; null when status is PENDING_SIGNATURE.

signed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of NovaSeal signing; null when PENDING_SIGNATURE.

stats.description: Extension block for downstream consumers. Additions are non-breaking.

compression_dict_id.description: Zstd dictionary ID; null means no compression dictionary was used.

prev_commit_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the previous commit's canonical JSON (model_dump_json()). Null for the genesis commit (version==1). Absent in commits written before OQ-027; present in all new commits. Used for hash-chain integrity verification on read.
